topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview of cancer hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic sets out the lecture aims, learning outcomes, and foundational framework of cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Deregulated growth signaling pathways in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how mutations in signaling cascades, including Wnt/beta-catenin and receptor tyrosine kinases, drive sustained proliferation.

topics.label: Block in terminal differentiation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how differentiation arrest contributes to tumorigenesis across hematological malignancies and colorectal carcinomas.

topics.label: Evasion of apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the mechanisms of apoptosis evasion through disruptions in p53 regulation and the Bax/BCL2 balance.

topics.label: Replicative immortality, telomeres, and senescence
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine cellular lifespan limitations, telomere maintenance through TERT activation, and p53-mediated stress and senescent responses before summarizing intrinsic growth-control hallmarks.

topics.label: Cancer metabolism and oncometabolites
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine metabolic reprogramming in cancer cells, including the Warburg effect, tissue-specific metabolic profiles, and oncometabolite-generating mutations.

topics.label: Induction of tumor angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic addresses the angiogenic switch, tissue vascularisation requirements, and therapeutic targeting of tumor blood supply.

topics.label: Metastatic dissemination and clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics outline the biological steps of metastasis, the seed-and-soil hypothesis, and genomic characteristics of metastatic clones.

topics.label: Closing remarks and recommended reading
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with references to current literature and practical course information.
